sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Soft Snake Sword (灵蛇软剑) is a one-handed blade in Phantom Blade Zero's primary weapon set. Deflects and cuts threads. Threads are a recurring obstacle type, so this is a utility slot rather than a damage slot.

sections.title: Weapon Class and Slot
sections.content: Soft Snake Sword (灵蛇软剑) occupies the Primary slot, and it is classed as One-handed. Soul carries two primary blades and two secondary Phantom Edges at once, and switching between the four refills stamina rather than costing it - which is what keeps a combo chain running. Sha-chi is a separate pool, spent on heavy attacks and blocks. The full class lists are on the blade index.

sections.title: Stats and Effects
sections.content: Not confirmed post-launch. Phantom Blade Zero does not publish a numeric stat sheet for individual weapons, and no measurement of this one has been recorded, so no damage, scaling or speed figure is given here. A number invented from how the weapon looks is exactly the kind of filler this page exists to avoid.

sections.title: How It Plays
sections.content:
The reason to carry it is its property rather than a damage number: Deflects attacks and cuts threads.

Switching to it mid-combo refills stamina, so its practical job is to extend a chain past the point where the blade you were using runs dry. See the combat system for how the swap window works.

sections.title: How to Obtain
sections.content:
Mandate Encampment, Path of the Baishan's Fall.

Acquisition points are taken from the acquisition table on the weapons hub, which is kept in step with this page - if a route is corrected there, it is corrected here.
